cards.title: First conditional
cards.body: Real future possibility. If + present simple, will + base.
cards.body_cz: Reálná budoucnost. If + přítomný prostý, will + základ.
points: Order can flip: I will stay if it rains.

cards.title: Examples

rows: If it rains, I will stay home.
If you study, you will pass.
Když se budeš učit, uděláš to.
When I finish, I will call you.

points: when often similar for future time

cards.title: Negatives

rows: If it doesn't rain, we will go out.
If you don't hurry, you will miss the train.
She won't pass if she doesn't study.

points: don't/doesn't in if-clause · won't in result

examples.en: What will you do if it rains?
Will you help me if I ask?
